airzone_cloud.title: Airzone Cloud
airzone_cloud.subtitle: A read-only companion for your Airzone account.
airzone_cloud.separate: These data stay separate from local gateways. A cloud outage does not block local controls.
airzone_cloud.state.expired: Airzone access session expired; renewal is available.
airzone_cloud.state.migration_pending: The connection must be renewed for this version of Moli.
airzone_cloud.password_help: Enter your credentials only here. The password is cleared from the form before sending and is not stored in Moli.
airzone_cloud.no_persistence: The vault is not available to retain this session.
airzone_cloud.no_installations: No installation returned for this account.
airzone_cloud.stale: Last known reading · old data or error
airzone_cloud.poll_help: The selected device is read every 30 seconds while this page is visible. Missing data remain unreported.
airzone_cloud.errors.busy: Too many recent reads. Wait before refreshing.
airzone_cloud.errors.missing: This resource is no longer available for the account.
airzone_cloud.errors.invalid: This read is not available with these parameters.
airzone_cloud.errors.failed: Airzone cloud could not respond. Local gateways continue to operate.
airzone_cloud.errors.network: Cloud connection interrupted or timed out. Previous readings are retained.
airzone_cloud.errors.invalid_response: Unrecognized Airzone response; no data replaced the last reading.
airzone_cloud.schedules_scope: Scenarios and schedules are not exposed by this Web API. Integrating them requires developer access to another Airzone API.
airzone_cloud.include_devices: Include its devices in the read
airzone_cloud.errors.moli_auth: Your Moli session has expired. Confirm your code to resume reading.
airzone_cloud.errors.cloud_auth: The Airzone account session must be renewed. Reconnect this account.
airzone_cloud.errors.cloud_forbidden: This Airzone account cannot access this information. Choose another device or check its permissions.
airzone_cloud.errors.migration_pending: The Airzone session must be renewed for this version of Moli.
airzone_cloud.errors.storage: The session cannot be saved in the vault. Check Moli configuration.
airzone_cloud.errors.incomplete_inventor: The Airzone inventory is incomplete. No partial inventory replaced your selection.
airzone_cloud.errors.unavailable: The Airzone Cloud companion is unavailable on this instance.
